# Data Source: okta_captcha

Retrieves the properties of a specified CAPTCHA instance

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "okta_captcha" "test" {
  name       = "testAcc_replace_with_uuid"
  type       = "HCAPTCHA"
  site_key   = "random_key"
  secret_key = "random_secret_key"
}

data "okta_captcha" "test" {
  id = okta_captcha.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the captcha.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the CAPTCHA instance
- `site_key` (String) The site key issued from the CAPTCHA provider to render a CAPTCHA on a page
- `type` (String) The type of CAPTCHA provider
